# JobDeck

> Mobile-first job management for tradespeople — create quotes, track jobs, and send invoices in seconds from your phone.

JobDeck helps plumbers, electricians, builders, and other tradespeople run their business without the paperwork. Features include fast quote creation (including voice input), job tracking, and one-tap invoicing. UK-focused with £ currency and 20% VAT defaults. Free and Pro plans available.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of JobDeck features, how it works, and pricing.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free and Pro plan comparison.
- [Install](/install): Add JobDeck to your phone's home screen as a PWA.
- [Sign in or create account](/auth): Access your JobDeck account.
